description: Inspect an image without decoding pixels: format, dimensions (EXIF-orientation aware), megapixels, animation, sha256, EXIF summary (camera, exposure, GPS). Body: { "image": "<base64>" }. Max ~190KB input image (the service caps POST bodies at 256KB, base64 included). Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/image-info

image.description: Base64 / data URI / URL-safe base64 image (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, ...); max ~190KB decoded (256KB POST body limit)

include_exif_tags.description: Include raw EXIF tag map (default true)

name: image_info
title: Image Info
